# pulse_tag (Data Source)

Resolves one tag in the organization derived from the configured automation credential. Configure either `id`, or the exact `purpose` and `name` pair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pulse_tag" "network" {
  purpose = "filter"
  name    = "network"
}

output "network_tag_id" {
  value = data.pulse_tag.network.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Tag UUID. Configure this alone, or configure `purpose` and `name` instead.
- `name` (String) Exact tag name. Must be configured with `purpose` when `id` is omitted.
- `purpose` (String) Tag purpose, `relevance` or `filter`. Must be configured with `name` when `id` is omitted.

### Read-Only

- `display_label` (String) Optional human-readable tag label.
- `icon` (String) Optional tag icon identifier.
